title: Mantis World
description: This mod was developed by Murav4ik studios. This mod adds different insect bosses. Currently in fashion there are: ant mandible claw, Ant Lord boss.
body: This mod was developed by Murav4ik studios. This mod adds different insect bosses. Currently in fashion there are: ant mandible claw, Ant Lord boss. In the future, there will be some bosses from the Hollow Knight series of games.
